title: 3 things to do to live with integrity
html:
Greetings!

Let's start the year off on something strong - In-teg-ri-ty

  1. Steadfast adherence to a strict moral or ethical code.

  2. The state of being unimpaired; soundness.

  3. The quality or condition of being whole or undivided; completeness.

Integrity is based on keeping agreements. Every day you make agreements and every day you are judged on whether you keep them or not. Consistently doing what you say you will attach names like reliable and trustworthy to you.

Here are three things to do to live with integrity;

  1. When you always tell the truth, people trust you.

  2. When you do what you say, as promised, people respect you.

  3. When you make others feel special, people like you.

Start to do these three things this year and the rewards will be numerous.

Kind regards,

Glenn Edley

Quote for the week

“Real integrity is doing the right thing, knowing that nobody's going to know whether you did it or not.”

– Oprah Winfrey
